You said:You

what settings to set up shared folder

ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

Since you want to transfer your Homework 4 ZIP from Ubuntu to your Windows Downloads folder, configure the VirtualBox shared folder as follows.

1. Shared Folder Settings

Based on your screenshot, use these settings:

Setting

Value

Folder Path

C:\Users\avant\Downloads

Folder Name

Downloads

Mount Point

Leave blank

Read-only

Unchecked

Auto-mount

Checked

Make Machine-permanent

Checked

Make Global

Unchecked

Why these settings?

  • Auto-mount: Automatically makes the Windows Downloads folder accessible in Ubuntu.

  • Make Machine-permanent: Keeps the shared folder configured after restarting the VM.

  • Read-only unchecked: Allows Ubuntu to copy your ZIP into Windows Downloads.

  • Mount Point blank: Lets VirtualBox use its default location.

Click OK, then OK again to save.

2. Verify the shared folder in Ubuntu

Open your Ubuntu terminal and run:

Bash
ls /media/

You should see something similar to:

Plain text
sf_Downloads

Then run:

Bash
ls /media/sf_Downloads

You should see the files currently in your Windows Downloads folder.

3. Copy your Homework 4 ZIP to Windows

Once you've created your ZIP, run:

Bash
cp ~/CSCE-465-765-HW4.zip /media/sf_Downloads/

Your ZIP should now appear in:

Plain text
C:\Users\avant\Downloads

You can then upload it directly from Windows.

4. If you get "Permission denied"

Your Ubuntu user may need access to the vboxsf group.

Run:

Bash
sudo usermod -aG vboxsf "$USER"

Then restart your Ubuntu VM:

Bash
sudo reboot

After restarting, try accessing /media/sf_Downloads again.

For now, set the four checkboxes as shown in the table, save the settings, and run ls /media/ in Ubuntu. Tell me what appears, and we'll proceed with transferring your Homework 4 ZIP.

You said:You

in the vm, it said i don't have permission to view the contents of the folder

ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

That usually happens because your Ubuntu user doesn't have permission to access VirtualBox shared folders. We can fix this by adding your user to the vboxsf group.

Step 1 — Add your Ubuntu user to the shared-folder group

Open the Ubuntu terminal and run:

Bash
sudo usermod -aG vboxsf "$USER"

Enter your Ubuntu password if prompted. No output usually means the command succeeded.

Step 2 — Restart your Ubuntu VM

Run:

Bash
sudo reboot

This is necessary for the new group membership to take effect.

Step 3 — Verify access

After Ubuntu restarts, open the terminal and run:

Bash
groups

You should see vboxsf among the groups.

Then run:

Bash
ls /media/sf_Downloads

You should now see the contents of your Windows Downloads folder.

Step 4 — Transfer your Homework 4 ZIP

Once the shared folder is accessible, run:

Bash
cp ~/CSCE-465-765-HW4.zip /media/sf_Downloads/

The ZIP should appear in your Windows Downloads folder.

Start with Steps 1–3. If you still get a permission error, send me the output of groups and ls -ld /media/sf_Downloads, and I'll help identify what's preventing access.
